entries.root_cause: audit C-17 / B-NYI-1: the published Zone-K LCR is now on disk (data/raw/capacity-deliverability/nyiso/nyiso.csv, value_pu 1.052/1.053/1.065) but it is a PEAK-capacity ratio, while this is an all-hours energy self-supply fraction — a rule-14 boundary mismatch: substituting the LCR% (~1.05) or the TSL-implied ~0.94 peak fraction over-forces ~2x the physical LI generation, and any scalar reproducing ~0.45 requires a load-duration haircut tuned to the realized share (rule-12 pin). The faithful fix is a peak-capacity/TSL MECHANISM, not a scalar re-ground; 0.45 left in place — open: https://github.com/jessicacohen554-cyber/market-simulator/issues/1345
